summary: Frontend testing of consistent AppHeader across pages and RoomEditor improvements (smaller device defaults, edit size dialog, real-time updates). All requested features verified working.

issues: RoomEditor uses its own custom header (not AppHeader) - Logout/ThemeToggle are NOT accessible while inside the room editor modal. If consistent header is required everywhere including modals, RoomEditor header should also include ThemeToggle and Logout buttons. Currently only has Back and Edit Room / Delete Room / Add Device.
Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' on Add/Edit Device dialogs - accessibility warning from Radix UI

action_items: Optional: Consider including ThemeToggle and Logout buttons in the RoomEditor header, or replace RoomEditor's custom header with the AppHeader for full consistency.
Optional: Add DialogDescription to Add Device / Edit Device / Edit Room dialogs to fix Radix accessibility warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: TVSetups.js onUpdate: fetchData() is async but rooms.find is called synchronously on stale state which may cause intermittent stale-state issues. Consider making fetchData return the new rooms and using that value directly, or add a useEffect in RoomEditor to sync devices state when the room prop's devices array changes.

RoomEditor.js line 39: useState(room.devices || []) only initializes once. If parent passes updated room with different devices, the state won't sync automatically. This is a latent bug even though the current addDevice manually calls setDevices(res.data.devices).
seed_data_creation: Added TEST_RealTime and TEST_NewDev devices in Dhoma 3 / Dhoma 1 during testing - main agent may want to clean these up
context_for_next_testing_agent: AppHeader verified on /home (LandingPage), /tv-setups (TVSetups), /admin (AdminDashboard) - shows Logo, user info, Hub button, Back button, Theme toggle (Sun/Moon), and Logout button all with data-testid. Theme toggle switches html.class from 'light' to 'dark'. Room Editor: Add Device dialog has Width/Height inputs (defaults: TV 15x10, Hello 5x5, Whiteboard 8x12, Room Sign 4x5, Bed 12x20). Edit Device pencil icon in sidebar opens Edit Device dialog with Width/Height inputs. New devices appear in canvas + sidebar + Total count immediately after Add. Existing legacy devices in Dhoma 1 are still large (30x24 TV, 22x54 Bed) because they were created before the size defaults changed - this is not a bug.
